description: Defines the 'cell_configuration' class which manages cell-specific radio configuration parameters for a scheduler, including methods for TDD/FDD mode checks, symbol activity, and coreset retrieval.

classes.name: cell_configuration
classes.description: Manages cell configuration parameters, including carrier info, BWP resources, CSI-RS resources, and slot activity checks.

methods.name: is_tdd
methods.description: Checks if the cell is configured in TDD mode.

methods.name: is_fully_dl_enabled
methods.description: Checks if downlink is fully enabled for a given slot.

methods.name: is_fully_ul_enabled
methods.description: Checks if uplink is fully enabled for a given slot.

methods.name: is_dl_enabled
methods.description: Checks if downlink is active for at least one symbol in a slot.

methods.name: is_ul_enabled
methods.description: Checks if uplink is active for at least one symbol in a slot.

methods.name: get_nof_dl_symbol_per_slot
methods.description: Returns the number of downlink symbols in a slot.

methods.name: get_nof_ul_symbol_per_slot
methods.description: Returns the number of uplink symbols in a slot.

methods.name: get_common_coreset
methods.description: Retrieves the coreset configuration for a given coreset ID.

methods.name: is_pucch_f0_and_f2
methods.description: Checks if the cell is configured with PUCCH Format 0 and 2 resources.

methods.name: use_msg3_transform_precoder
methods.description: Determines if transform precoding is used for Msg3 based on configuration.
